title: ScoringRules
description: The 'data' object of Data/Gameplay/Scoring.json. Mirrors FLRScoringRules (Source/LRGameplay/Public/LRScoring.h).

MetersPerDistancePoint.description: Meters to drive for one distance point, before the speed multiplier.

SpeedTiers.description: Speed multiplier table. A tier applies from MinKmh (inclusive) up to the next tier.

MinKmh.description: Lowest speed of the tier, km/h.

Multiplier.description: Multiplier of the distance points in this tier.

NearMissBasePoints.description: Points of a near miss before any factor.

RelativeSpeedReferenceKmh.description: Relative speed that gives a factor of 1, km/h.

RelativeSpeedFactorMin.description: Lower clamp of the relative speed factor.

RelativeSpeedFactorMax.description: Upper clamp of the relative speed factor.

OncomingFactor.description: Factor against a vehicle driving in the opposite direction.

ThreadTheNeedleFactor.description: Factor when passing between two vehicles at the same time.

ComboWindowSeconds.description: Seconds a combo stays alive after a near miss.

ComboStepPerChain.description: Combo multiplier gained per chained near miss.

ComboMaxMultiplier.description: Upper limit of the combo multiplier.

ComboBreakSpeedKmh.description: Below this player speed the combo breaks and cannot grow, km/h.
